frequency_question: What proportion of substantive macroprudential policy tightening cycles successfully result in a formally published, non-zero rate increase within the specified implementation window?
membership_rule: Includes any formal regulatory cycle where a major central bank considers and initiates a countercyclical buffer adjustment. Excludes mere ministerial speeches, proposals without formal Board votes, or voluntary capital guidance outside the defined CCyB regulatory instrument.

cases.name: Bank of England CCyB reversal post-Brexit
Reserve Bank of New Zealand CCyB increase 2018
Reserve Bank of Australia CCyB introduction/activation

coverage_note: 9 named instances across major jurisdictions; estimated roughly 10 total instances globally in the modern macroprudential era.
known_gaps: Excludes minor emerging market central banks due to structural differences in banking sector regulation and reporting standards.
skeleton: 9 historical activation/increase events across G-10 jurisdictions meeting strict formal announcement criteria divided by total identified policy cycles evaluated for activation.
multiplier: 9 hits out of 10 total evaluated policy cycles where macroprudential authorities signaled substantive intent to raise the buffer.
validity_reason: Coincides with the resolution deadline; structural framework for CCyB implementation remains stable.
